note: Source of truth for app metadata. apps/index.html renders its OWN custom display order; this file is the chronological list.

apps.title: Tom
apps.tagline: A music machine — melodies in seconds, songs like Lego
apps.note: A free, open-source (MIT) music machine that runs entirely in the browser, plus a CLI. Dial in a melody in seconds or snap a whole song together from blocks like Lego — every note generated from a seed, so the same seed always makes the same music, and it's all royalty-free. Exports WAV, MIDI and JSON; a share link's hashtag is the whole song. Scores Monkr's animated mockups with jingles that land on the end card.

apps.title: Scripture Alone
apps.tagline: The Word, and nothing in the way
apps.note: A free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) Bible for iPhone, iPad, Mac (the iPad app on Apple silicon) and Apple Watch — the ASV offline from install and the BSB and KJV a one-time download away, all with full-text search and words of Christ in red; highlights, favorites and multi-passage notes (exported as PDF, Markdown or text); camera sermon notes with on-device text recognition; Listen with system voices or Mi Speaks Studio voices; Study mode with cross-references and Calvin, Gill and Jamieson-Fausset-Brown commentary; offline maps, a timeline and charts; verse images and share links that rebuild the card in the browser from the URL fragment; widgets; a standalone Watch app; Keepsake Bibles; and private iCloud sync. No ads, no trackers, no accounts. Coming soon to the App Store.

apps.title: Lathe
apps.tagline: A free Mac downloader, and the media engine behind Sami
apps.note: An open-source (Apache-2.0) Swift media engine that runs entirely on device — encoding, frames, tags, chapters, subtitles, AV1 and Flash through the system frameworks with no subprocesses — and a free, notarized Mac downloader built on it: paste links or browse signed in, Tor built in, hand-off to Sami.

apps.title: Kern
apps.note: Word puzzles about handling letters with care — Wheel, Search, and Chain share one fair par-based score inside eighteen living worlds that react to the words you find. Generated music, Game Center daily leaderboards, fully offline. No ads, no IAP, no data collection.

apps.title: Revela
apps.note: A film camera that lives in your phone — honest rolls with real develop times, full-resolution RAW-first lab scans, movie reels, an AirPlay projector, and an earned darkroom. No account, no tracking, one price.

apps.title: Haven
apps.tagline: A private, post-quantum social network for the people you love
apps.note: Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted, post-quantum social network for friends & family. No servers, no tracking, no ads. Nobody holds your keys.

apps.title: Tri-Add
apps.note: A complete, ground-up rebuild of the original 2014 Tri-Add — relaunched June 2026 with additive + subtractive mixing, inversions, and turn-based multiplayer.

apps.title: Tilebreak
apps.tagline: Match. Combo. Clear. Polished Mahjong solitaire

apps.title: Blip
apps.tagline: Featherlight macOS menu bar system monitor
apps.note: macOS menu-bar network & S.M.A.R.T. monitor with live MTR traceroute map, per-volume speed tests, kill-process controls, and a full Shortcuts (App Intents) catalog.

apps.title: Monkr
apps.note: A free, open-source (MIT) device mockup generator that runs entirely in the browser — nothing is uploaded. Frames App Store screenshots and animates mockups into video, with a CLI that powers the App Store screenshot pipeline behind every app here.

apps.title: Sami
apps.note: Media toolbox built on Lathe: a quality-aware photo, video & PDF optimizer with a visually lossless mode, plus Convert & Combine, a bulk tag editor, Live Photo tools and Flash movie capture, with AVIF/WebP/AV1/MP3 output. Watched folders on the Mac, network-aware throttling for NAS and cloud drives, fully scriptable from Shortcuts, and translated into nine languages.

apps.title: Enter Space
apps.tagline: Local-feeling access to every cloud you use
apps.note: Unified, local-feeling access to 100 cloud providers across iPhone, iPad, Mac & Apple TV — with full-content Spotlight indexing, encrypted offline mirror (Keep Offline), 24 Shortcuts & Siri actions, and an Apple Watch companion that syncs your cloud media to your wrist and flips through a photo folder on the watch face. Scheduled syncs add rate-limit tuning (TPS limit, low-level retries, auto-abort) for providers like pCloud.

apps.title: Luma Editor
apps.note: Non-destructive photo editor that matches a look you admire and hands it back as real sliders — tone curves, an eight-band colour mixer, split toning, black & white, masks, crop and lens correction, retouch, burst culling, presets and video, right inside the Photos app. Universal on iPhone, iPad & Mac, in nine languages.

apps.title: Embr
apps.note: Debt-payoff tracker that lets you watch each balance literally burn away as you pay it down — with an Apple Watch app and complication showing your live payoff rings, plus Siri & Shortcuts.

apps.title: Ari Helper
apps.note: All-in-one AI chat with on-device LLMs plus your favorite cloud models — and an Apple Watch app that remote-controls the chat from your wrist while your paired iPhone runs the model.

apps.title: Mi Speaks
apps.note: Text-to-speech reader for any written content, with a standalone Apple Watch player that reads along through the built-in speaker and highlights each word. v1.4.4 live; v1.5.0 in review.

apps.title: Pano Owl
apps.note: Originally launched March 2021. Fully relaunched as a 2.x ground-up rebuild on a hybrid OpenCV + Metal stitch engine (PanoKit) with a SwiftUI interface — true 360° equirectangular output, gigapixel memory-bounded stitching, an immersive in-app 360 viewer, and background continued-processing stitching from Shortcuts. Live on iOS, iPadOS & macOS.
